description: Read a publication module (PMC) as a table of contents: the pmEntry tree with titles, and for each dmRef/pmRef the resolved target (file, techName/infoName, issue) from the CSDB. Also returns the PM identification and a verification status.

csdbDirs.description: CSDB folders to search for data modules by DMC, referenced objects, ACT/CCT/PCT and BREX (default: S1000D_CSDB_DIR / the config file). When given, these folders replace S1000D_CSDB_DIR and the csdbDirs of the config file (they are not added to them); folders that do not exist are skipped and reported in _notes.

pmc.description: PMC to read from the CSDB (e.g. "S1000DBIKE-B6865-EPWG1-00"; "PMC-" prefix optional). Alternative to path/xml.

verify.description: How much to verify before reading: "schema" (default) runs XSD validation only; "full" also checks BREX along the brexDmRef chain and resolves references; "none" skips verification (reported as not-run).

xml.description: The document as an XML string (alternative to path; max 5 MB).

name: read_publication_module
